name: DEAD INTERNET THEORY: SUPERSTARS
source:
In the new age of extreme parasocialism and the death of human nuance.

Eighteen digital superstars drawn from WETA's Nexia, the platform that owns the world's attention, are forced into the first ever legally sanctioned killing game. The Celebration of Humanity. Monetised, publicised, and broadcast to a literal majority of mankind.

Governments stand paralysed. Authorities stand complicit. Above the chaos, divine beings place their bets on who walks out alive. The Divinity Tower stands above the sky and the rules are absolute. Eighteen lives. One Holy Grail. A single wish, unlimited and unchecked, granted to whoever survives.

The wrong hands must not have it.
